hypotheses.S0_same_codebook_alignment_is_adjudicati: For at least one of Layers 1-3, leave-one-relation-out alignment R2 is >=0.30 in every ordered initialization pair and omitted relation.
hypotheses.S1_rule_edit_is_initialization_invariant: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, mapped same-rule edits have fidelity >=0.50 and accuracy no more than 0.15 below the target model's own semantic edit.
hypotheses.S2_same_rule_beats_wrong_rule: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, same-rule edits beat norm-matched wrong-rule edits by >=0.20 fidelity or >=0.15 target accuracy.
hypotheses.S3_final_effect_matches_target_answer_in: At adjudicative Layer 3, target generic-answer fidelity is within 0.10 of mapped semantic fidelity and both are >=0.70.
hypotheses.S4_random_codebooks_break_linear_invaria: Same-codebook mean alignment R2 exceeds the prior different-codebook leave-relation-out mean by >=0.50 at an adjudicative layer, and mapped semantic fidelity exceeds it by >=0.30.
